import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.calibration import calibration_curve

# 1. Load datasets and label
df_pos = pd.read_parquet('train.parquet')
df_neg = pd.read_parquet('train_neg.parquet')
df_pos['success'] = 1
df_neg['success'] = 0
df = pd.concat([df_pos, df_neg], ignore_index=True)

# 2. Compute lengths, drop empty
df['prompt_length'] = df['prompt'].str.split().apply(len)
df['edit_length'] = df['edit'].str.split().apply(len)
df = df[(df['prompt_length'] > 0) & (df['edit_length'] > 0)]

# 3. Standardize prompt_length
df['prompt_length_std'] = (
    df['prompt_length'] - df['prompt_length'].mean()
) / df['prompt_length'].std()

# 4. Linear regression: edit_length ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)
model_ols = smf.ols('edit_length ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)', data=df).fit()
coef_ols = model_ols.params['prompt_length_std']
ci_ols = model_ols.conf_int().loc['prompt_length_std']
p_ols = model_ols.pvalues['prompt_length_std']
print("OLS Regression: edit_length ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)")
print(f"Coefficient: {coef_ols:.4f}, 95% CI [{ci_ols[0]:.4f}, {ci_ols[1]:.4f}], p-value {p_ols:.2e}\n")

# 5. GLM logistic regression: success ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)
model_glm = smf.glm('success ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)',
                    data=df, family=sm.families.Binomial()).fit()
coef_glm = model_glm.params['prompt_length_std']
ci_glm = model_glm.conf_int().loc['prompt_length_std']
p_glm = model_glm.pvalues['prompt_length_std']
odds_rat = np.exp(coef_glm)
ci_odds = np.exp(ci_glm)
print("GLM Logistic Regression: success ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)")
print(f"Coef (std prompt): {coef_glm:.4f}, OR {odds_rat:.3f}, 95% CI [{ci_odds[0]:.3f}, {ci_odds[1]:.3f}], p-value {p_glm:.2e}\n")

# 6. Model performance: AUC
y_pred = model_glm.predict(df)
auc = roc_auc_score(df['success'], y_pred)
print(f"Model AUC: {auc:.3f}\n")

# Calibration curve
y_true = df['success']
prob_true, prob_pred = calibration_curve(y_true, y_pred, n_bins=10)
plt.figure(figsize=(5, 5))
plt.plot(prob_pred, prob_true, marker='o', label='GLM Calibration')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle='--', color='gray')
plt.xlabel('Mean Predicted Probability')
plt.ylabel('Fraction of Positives')
plt.title('Calibration Curve')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 7. Scatterplot of prompt_length vs edit_length (sampled)
sample = df.sample(n=10000, random_state=1)
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))
plt.scatter(sample['prompt_length'], sample['edit_length'],
            c=sample['success'], cmap='bwr', alpha=0.3)
plt.xlabel('Prompt Length (tokens)')
plt.ylabel('Edit Length (tokens)')
plt.title('Prompt vs Edit Length by Success (blue=success, red=failure)')
plt.colorbar(label='Success')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

# 8. Bin prompt_length into quartiles, ensure 4 bins
try:
    df['prompt_bin'] = pd.qcut(df['prompt_length'], 4, labels=[f'Q{i}' for i in range(1,5)], duplicates='drop')
    if df['prompt_bin'].nunique() < 4:
        raise ValueError
except:
    df['prompt_bin'] = pd.cut(df['prompt_length'], 4, labels=[f'Q{i}' for i in range(1,5)])

# 9. Bar plot of success rate by prompt_bin
bin_stats = df.groupby('prompt_bin')['success'].mean().reset_index()
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.bar(bin_stats['prompt_bin'], bin_stats['success'], color='skyblue')
plt.xlabel('Prompt Length Quartile')
plt.ylabel('Success Rate')
plt.title('Success Rate by Prompt Length Quartile')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import numpy as np

{"code":"import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.calibration import calibration_curve

# 1. Load datasets and label
df_pos = pd.read_parquet('train.parquet')
df_neg = pd.read_parquet('train_neg.parquet')
df_pos['success'] = 1
df_neg['success'] = 0
df = pd.concat([df_pos, df_neg], ignore_index=True)

# 2. Compute lengths, drop empty
df['prompt_length'] = df['prompt'].str.split().apply(len)
df['edit_length'] = df['edit'].str.split().apply(len)
df = df[(df['prompt_length'] > 0) & (df['edit_length'] > 0)]

# 3. Standardize prompt_length
df['prompt_length_std'] = (
    df['prompt_length'] - df['prompt_length'].mean()
) / df['prompt_length'].std()

# 4. Linear regression: edit_length ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)
model_ols = smf.ols('edit_length ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)', data=df).fit()
coef_ols = model_ols.params['prompt_length_std']
ci_ols = model_ols.conf_int().loc['prompt_length_std']
p_ols = model_ols.pvalues['prompt_length_std']
print("OLS Regression: edit_length ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)")
print(f"Coefficient: {coef_ols:.4f}, 95% CI [{ci_ols[0]:.4f}, {ci_ols[1]:.4f}], p-value {p_ols:.2e}\n")

# 5. GLM logistic regression: success ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)
model_glm = smf.glm('success ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)',
                    data=df, family=sm.families.Binomial()).fit()
coef_glm = model_glm.params['prompt_length_std']
ci_glm = model_glm.conf_int().loc['prompt_length_std']
p_glm = model_glm.pvalues['prompt_length_std']
odds_rat = np.exp(coef_glm)
ci_odds = np.exp(ci_glm)
print("GLM Logistic Regression: success ~ prompt_length_std + C(task_id)")
print(f"Coef (std prompt): {coef_glm:.4f}, OR {odds_rat:.3f}, 95% CI [{ci_odds[0]:.3f}, {ci_odds[1]:.3f}], p-value {p_glm:.2e}\n")

# 6. Model performance: AUC
y_pred = model_glm.predict(df)
auc = roc_auc_score(df['success'], y_pred)
print(f"Model AUC: {auc:.3f}\n")

# Calibration curve
y_true = df['success']
prob_true, prob_pred = calibration_curve(y_true, y_pred, n_bins=10)
plt.figure(figsize=(5, 5))
plt.plot(prob_pred, prob_true, marker='o', label='GLM Calibration')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], linestyle='--', color='gray')
plt.xlabel('Mean Predicted Probability')
plt.ylabel('Fraction of Positives')
plt.title('Calibration Curve')
plt.legend()
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

sample = df.sample(n=10000, random_state=1)
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 6))

            c=sample['success'], cmap='bwr', alpha=0.3)

plt.ylabel('Edit Length (tokens)')
plt.title('Prompt vs Edit Length by Success (blue=success, red=failure)')

# 8. Bin prompt_length into quartiles, ensure 4 bins

    df['prompt_bin'] = pd.qcut(df['prompt_length'], 4, labels=[f'Q{i}' for i in range(1,5)], duplicates='drop')
    if df['prompt_bin'].nunique() < 4:

# 9. Bar plot of success rate by prompt_bin

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))

      "objective":"Test whether the presence of numbers in the natural‐language prompt is associated with more conservative (smaller magnitude) edits.",

      "objective":"Determine whether molecular complexity at the input (via SMILES length) hampers edit success.",
